_doc: Host matrix (V9). bin/_doctor_host.py reads it and repact-doctor prints one host line; an untested host is a note, never a refusal. 'tested' means the plugin's test suite passed on that Claude Code version, which uses simulated hook events. 'live' lists what real sessions on that version have exercised; anything not listed there is not proven live.
